seoTitle: Gérard & Fils - Home removals for individuals in Brussels
seoDesc: Are you a private individual looking for a reliable company to manage your move? Gérard & Fils is here to support you at every stage.
h1: Removals for individuals in every municipality of Brussels

body.p: Are you moving from a house or an apartment? A professional removal company will be invaluable for handling the various arrangements, saving your energy and saving you time.

Present in all 19 municipalities of Brussels, including Forest, we put two generations of experience to work supporting individuals with their project. Thanks to modern equipment, the professionalism of our removers and suitable solutions, every stage goes smoothly, from preparation to final installation.

House or apartment, small or large volume, short or long distance: every move is unique, which is why we take pride in offering a genuine à la carte service that meets your every requirement while respecting your budget.
Our team of professionals can handle just the loading, secure transport and unloading of your furniture and boxes at the destination, but is also qualified to carry out the following tasks with care

ul: Packing and wrapping of fragile items

body.p: Depending on the situation and your requests, we can also include the following optional services:

ul: Moving pianos and other bulky items
Hire of furniture storage in Brussels to store your belongings temporarily
Hire of a furniture lift or hoist to take your furniture out through the window
Cleaning of the house or apartment before and after the move

body.p: Our quotes, always detailed and free, clearly set out the various services and their costs: we are keen to build a relationship of trust with you and to meet your specific requirements in a personalised way because, for our family business, every customer is unique.

Contact us today to benefit from the quality of our services. We make sure your furniture and personal belongings are transported with the greatest care, so that you can settle in under the best possible conditions in central Brussels.

Our team also works in other municipalities of the capital, notably Schaerbeek, offering the same level of professionalism and peace of mind to every customer. We adapt our solutions to the particularities of each neighbourhood, to guarantee a smooth and efficient service whatever the complexity of the move.

sections.h: Would you like to entrust us with your move?

body.p: Have a question about dismantling and reassembling your furniture, transport with or without a lift, or handling specific volumes? Do not hesitate to contact us by phone or to complete our online form. We will get back to you quickly to arrange a home visit in your municipality. That way we can offer you a clear, tailored proposal.
